generalCriterionList.description: The bidders fulfilling all rules/conditions said in the tender document are eligible. Latest Circulars from Govt. are also applicable.

As per tender Agreement clause 24.1, the successful tenderer shall submit the Security Deposit(Performance Security) infavour of Executive Engineer in the form of Bankers Cheque/Pay order for an amount of equivalent to 5% of the contract price and also an additional security for unbalanced tender amount in the form of FDR of any Nationalised Bank within 7 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance and shall enter into an agreement and the work shall be started within a week after agreement. The Name in the FDR/STAMP Paper as per Contractor License.

All the documents pertaining to technical bid should be attested by the gazetted officer not less than the grade of District Level Officer. If not said bid shall be rejected and he should be able to produce the attested document at any time, if required.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The contractor is supposed to purchase all required materials on his own for carrying out the work, and all the materials shall be tested for its quality prior to construction and its quality shall be of ISI standards.
An amount of 1% shall be deducted towards Labour Less from each of the running bill of the contractor.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable.
Conditional tenders are subjected for rejection.
Acceptance/Cancellation of the works are reserved by undersigned without any reasons for the same.

All bidders shall upload the details of the following documents: i) Contractor Registration. ii) Works completed in last 5 years. iii) Details of minimum quantities of work done in one year. iv) Yearly turnover from last 5 years. v) Present ongoing works. vi) Tener bid Capacity should be more than Tender amount

As per Director, Department of Mines and Geology Bengaluru Circular For the year 2023-24 dated: 07-11-2023, if the contractors fail to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit(MDP) along with the bill for the sub-minerals used for the works, action will be taken as per the said circular.

itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting stone aggregates of specific sizes to water bound macadam specification including spreading in uniform thickness, hand packing, rolling with vibratory roller in stages to proper grade and camber, applying and brooming requisite type of screening/ binding Materials to fill up the interstices of coarse aggregate, watering and compacting to the required density.  Mechanical means  Grading-I (63 mm to 45 mm) Using Screening Crushable type such as Moorum or Gravel

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting stone aggregates of specific sizes to water bound macadam specification including spreading in uniform thickness, hand packing, rolling with vibratory roller in stages to proper grade and camber, applying and brooming requisite type of screening/ binding Materials to fill up the interstices of coarse aggregate, watering and compacting to the required density.  Mechanical means  Grading-II (53 mm to 22.4 mm) Using Screening  Type B (11.2mm agg)

Prime Coat over WMM/WBM: Providing and applying primer coat with SS1 grade Bitumen Emulsion on prepared surface of granular base including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2 using mechanical means.
Tack coat on Granular surface treated with primer: Providing and applying tack coat with RS1 Bituminous Emulsion using emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.25 kg/m2 on Granular  Surface.

Providing, laying and rolling of close-graded premix surfacing material of 20 mm thickness composed of 11.2 mm to 0.09 mm (Type-A) or 13.2 mm to 0.09 mm (Type-B) aggregates using VG-30 bitumen to required line, grade and level to serve as wearing course on a previously prepared base, including mixing in a suitable hot mix plant of capacity not less than 40/60 TPH, laying and rolling with a Smooth wheeled roller finishing to required level and grade. Type - A
Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor
